protocol.source_prediction: unchanged full STFT U-Net; three unordered outputs and background
protocol.main_loss: existing whole-window PIT NMSE + coherence + background; 0.1 count CE
protocol.auxiliary: reference-energy-weighted KL of relative STFT source powers, existing waveform PIT assignment, background target zero
protocol.eps: relative 1e-8 smoothing of predicted power only; no phase/gain fitting
protocol.selection: minimum mean NMSE over counts2/3 including epoch0
protocol.acceptance: NMSE down AND complex SI-SDR up separately for counts2/3
protocol.diagnostic: same four TRAIN mixtures, each arm32 updates; discard weights, not generalized performance
protocol.data_scope: same frozen RFUAV records, same native band per center-aligned synthetic mixture

local_power_gap_analysis: posthoc descriptive; no exclusions or reselection
